Save GoGo

The Goblin chief GoGo is not the most aggressive or dangerous of goblins. That is why the Orcs have decided to execute him and replace him with a more evil, Orc-subservient Goblin. GoGo must be saved.

Objectives

Central island

Killing the Orcs

Taking GoGo away

Take GoGo to Barren Island

Find material to repair the bridge

Repair the bridge

Locations

Maps
The river and the islands

Authored rewards

PropertyValue
Experience700.0

These are the authored base rewards. Scripts, choices and game rules can change the final reward.
